6858.title: Retired plugin route state remains reachable after reload
6858.rootCauseOneLine: The failure helper captures the previous instance in the context retained by the replacement plugin's API callbacks.
6858.proposedFix: Capture a reload boolean instead of the previous LoadedPlugin in the failure helper; preserve the local previous instance for disposal and rollback.
6858.caveats: Verified with Node 22 on Linux, not the reported macOS environment. No production heap data was accessed; disable/enable and version reload were not separately measured.
